flows.title: Bulk schedule posts from a CSV
steps: Click the three-dot menu in the top-right corner of the screen, then click Bulk Import. The Import Posts popup appears.
Select the profiles you want to schedule messages for. Only X, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn are supported, and only one X profile can be selected at a time.
Drag your .CSV into the window or browse for the .CSV on your device.
Select the date format you want to use, U.S. format mm/dd/yyyy or International dd/mm/yyyy.
Optionally enter the tags you want applied to all posts, and optionally select Schedule posts as Drafts.
